id: title:Gilbert09:ride out transport cancellation rpc errors

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion recovery: adding transient transport cancellation to retryable RPC messages could prevent premature failure of warehouse ingestion workflows when the underlying connection closes mid-request, allowing recovery rather than permanent failure.
review.reason: Adds 'operation was canceled' to the set of retryable RPC messages and corresponding test assertions. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it distinguishes transient transport failures from intentional cancellations and updates both implementation and tests. review.uncertainty: The actual recovery benefit depends on warehouse ingestion workflows encountering this specific transient failure; no production incident or adoption is demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the implementation and test coverage, not on unverified outcomes.
